A well spent 15$
A coop-horror-ghost-detecting-game that I didn't know I needed. As a horror fan who doesn't really get scared in 99% of horror games I always appreciate one that can at least get me tense, and boy does this do it.
It can be a little clunky at times but seems to be steadily improving with more updates planned for 2023 which sound very exciting.

This game only got initially successful during the lockdowns of 2020. The gameplay loop is most enjoyed with friends and even then, i can only recommend it if you're playing with friends. Had this been released at any other time with the atrocious stock unity assets, buggy programming and the myriad of other defective aspects that i haven't even encountered myself, it would've been deader than a swarm of locust's devouring a harvest. 6 years after this game's release and the only thing Kinetic Games has to show for it is their legendary levels of sloth and wrath towards their playerbase, particularly centered around the subject of modding. Kinetic game's lifeforce seems to be attached to this eldritch abomination of a construction and any interference with it would instigate their instantaneous death. New content is never happening, expectations of overhauling the ancient database and assets might as well be the same as dreaming of living on Saturn. A game being frozen during it's early access "phase" if you can even call it that, for 6 years, isn't indicative of the developers working hard, it is them running away with the money and exposure they initially attained.

The new update is simply rubbish.

New Items make the game unplayable, ghost behavior is chaotic and no longer aligns with the corresponding ghost. A mimic shouldn't be f3cking MIMICKING THIRTY GHOST DURING ONE GHOST RUN. You ruined my fun.

I played this game with my own group of friends and rarely played public, most were okay; There were a few times you may get kicked randomly. All in all, a very fun game. Try it if you haven't!
Very fun. One of the best game I've played. New experience in every round and multiplayer is so chaotic.

To be honest, I am not a fan of horror games that much. I get easily scared by jumpscares, dark places, and creepy screams but my friends recommended this game to me because it doesn't have jumpscares. Well, just dark places and creepy screams, I guess. When I played this game for the first time, I was so scared and I get targeted by ghosts during hunting times a lot because I panic first before I act but as I play more games, I get used to the feeling and managed to be calm during games. For a horror game, this really did its job into giving people the fright even without the need of jumpscares, which is a nice thing. I recommend this game so much and I hope in the future, there are more challenges to this game to make it more interesting.

Fun game, but hard to play without sound (I'm deaf). Still exciting and fun to play with friends! Had a good night with my friend, who got his stream raided by a famous horror game YouTuber and streamer named Insym. The viewers helped us with the basics of the game and we won our fourth game ever! Definitely not a night that I will forget!

Horror games have never been my favourite genre, but this one is a lot of fun and has some really neat mechanics. It’s really cool how the game uses your mic and speech recognition to interact with you. I also really like the in-game voice chat system. The game uses proximity chat, which really helps add to the atmosphere. Additionally, everyone has a radio, which you can use to communicate with everyone, regardless of distance. However, the radios audio quality is not as clear and you cannot all speak at once, encouraging you to stick together and really making you feel alone when no one is near you. It’s also great that VR and non-VR users can play together. Overall, it’s just some good, spooky, fun.

It is worth playing only if you have a friend to play with.
This game may not shiver down your spine. However, it can give you some dread moments, making it a fun experience. It is definitely worth giving it a try for the moments it offers.

This game is so awesome if you like to get jump scared this is the game for you the ghost are so creepy and pop out of no were first game were i have gone in to a dark house and my nerves are on edge before anything even happens so good

Amazing co-op horror game, not the scariest but has its moments that'll make you jump. Alot of hilarious memories with friends. Played the game since launch and watched it evolve to get better and better with time.

Simple to pick up and alot of similar games in the genre are easy to find but barely any come close to Phasmo.

I very well enjoy phas as the game it is now. I haven't played too much of the new apocalypse update, but from what I seen so far there's been much improvement. I'm looking forwards what updates they'll have in the future. The custom game mode option and being able to choose not to lose your items was a nice touch. One downside I see is the new shop and how you add items. Might just be me, but I'm not a fan of it. Also not the biggest fan of the heartbeat sound when you die. I feel there should be an option to turn it down or have the ability to turn it off in the settings. In the future I hope to see maybe some more playable characters or some minor character customization. (such as maybe hats, changing shirt colors etc.) They made it clear more items will be coming to the shop which I'm very excited for.

As someone that´s not into Horror much, because i usually don´t enjoy long, mostly half cooked, Story in Horror-/Games or it just being a Jumpscare Fiesta, I gotta say i can´t get enough of this Gem that does it way better.

Got lots of Adrenaline, Combined with quite a bunch of Detective Work that often forces you out of your Comfort-Zone that you gonna hate but ultimately fall in love with. Pretty much endless Replayability.
Alot of Risk-Reward Decisions, a pretty huge Community over on Discord to find like minded Players to play with.
Which in my Opinion, makes the Game the Game.

Must-Buy for Groups of Friends that want to see their Friend-s and themselves in Horror, while working together for Victory.

Keeps timing out mid-match and the game just isn't fun no matter how many times I come back to it. It gets so incredibly stale, progression moves at a snails pace, and it feels like there's only two ways to enjoy the game. When you first play it and everything is still scary and new, and after you've invest a stupid amount of time to learn every possible mechanic and ghost behaviour down to the timing and intervals of their interactions, and being between these two is just so boring. It stops being scary and stops being fun, just waiting around for evidence to appear is worse than watching paint dry.

Phasmophobia in 2020 was a fun, somewhat silly, spooky party game where you'd put on a detective hat, identify a ghost within 15 minutes and then goof around a bit having fun.

Phasmophobia in 2021 is a super srs game where evidence is scarce and you spend 30 minutes wandering around a chilly house with no evidence or interactions to show for it and then you die.

Very scary I love it. A little complicated to begin with but once you get to grips with it you'll have a lot of fun. Best to play with friends! Also, play the tutorial instead of winging it, it's very informative.

The game is very good, if you want to be afraid this production will offer you that, if you want to have friends, it will also. Of course, what too much is not healthy and it starts to get boring over time, but it's very possible that when the full version comes out it might stop being boring. On a scale of 1 to 10, I rate this game a solid 8/10.

This game is always a lot of fun to play with friends. Many different game modes for different levels of players, including custom game mode. Tons of different pieces of equipment to help find and figure out the ghost. Just like any game, there is the occasional bug, but for being an indie game the devs are pretty on top of things.

I'm hoping in the future there's an option to have the game randomly pick a map specific to map size or a custom selection list. I like the random option, but when you only want to play smaller maps you can't really use this option.

Amazing game that is still getting updates. Definitely super fun with friends but can be played without them too! There's a bit of a knowledge barrier where you sort of just need to play the game for a while before it gets competitive but still very fun.
i really dont like when my friends force me to play this boring ahh game

Phasmophobia is a brilliant game with a few bugs. Developers keep their players interested by adding new ghosts. And just saying, by seeing how many games are trying to do what Phasmophobia has already achieved it's clear that they're doing something right and this game is a gem. It can be whatever you make it to be. A challenge, a fun experience, a puzzle or a horror. True, sometimes the ghost chooses to make that run your personal nightmare when after the third attempt at ouija board communication it still takes your sanity (if you have any left). But that's just a part of the game!
I don't know what to tell you guys, I've played this for over 80 hours and I'm still not a perfect hunter nor bored of this. :) One of my favorite games, 8,5/10.
Great game (very scary) and it is only continuing to improve with the development the devs are doing.

This game got stale after the first year it came out, the creator doesn't want mods but then also doesn't make any content himself, they just keep reworking maps and promising "Horror 2.0" is coming for like 4+ years

It's a pretty decent game with friends, but the UI is overcomplex and the game play can get repetitive really quickly. I have a few hundred hours on the game, and I haven't been getting much fun out of the game anymore, it'll still keep you entertained for a few hours though.
Lowkirkenuenly a fun game when you are getting diddled by a diddlegast. If you yell slurs at the ghosts it's less a horror game and more a co-op comp eviction simulator.

The way this game has progressed is extremely depressing. Had something special at some point but probably one of the worst studios out there handling it’s development. It upsets me a lot how much the fans gave them only to be treated like garbage. Updates took literal years & come out as the worst product they could possibly have been. Insane greed & entitlement ruined this game, kinetic doesn’t deserve anymore support.

If you're a fan of Ghost Adventure type shows and enjoy puzzles, you'll enjoy this! Typically I play a game and it gets easier, which causes me to lose interest. This one seems to keep me on my toes and it's hard to get the right answer! Also, the graphics are are great which leaves you feeling like you're actually there. Hard to play alone in the dark. 10/10.

Overall, it's a pretty neat game.
I've had plenty of great (yet horrifying) experiences, and the atmosphere is perfectly nailed along with the small sounds and events that can be heard (or happening to you) when you're exploring a map.
The only downsides I'd say is people hopping from server to server trying to fill in spaces, or the small number of maps, but both issues can easily be solved by a good group of friends.
For certain I can say that Phasmophobia is worth the cost whether it's full price or on sale.
I love horror games. Phasmophobia is a really fun game and my FAVOURITE game. I can play alone, with friends, or strangers. I've made a couple friends through Phasmophobia

Coming back to this game its changed a lot. Its very fun and there is a lot of times when things can be unpredictable very good game if you have a group of friends to play with, I would recommend it for sure.

10/10

It's a great horror game with some tactics and strategy involved that sets it apart from the rest. Also the ability to play in VR or on asymmetrical screens is a big plus. It doesn't require VR, yet VR and flat screen players can play together. Pretty sweet...should have picked it up sooner.

Ghost wasn't doing anything, so I insulted it's art and cat. Immediately got hunted and killed me lmfao.
There are a lot of janky things going on with this game, and I'm not particularly a fan of the jarring update.. but I have spent a lot of time playing on and off with friends and still find it quite enjoyable. Nightmare mode is a neat way to test your memory, and feels rewarding when you fit the pieces of the puzzle together correctly.

Me and my friends play this game every year around Halloween for one session. Every year we laugh about how the game hasn't changed and its so lame. The ghosts all kill you the same way every time and im not sure what the "stakes" are, so its just boring deduction/guessing game that isnt scary or really fun in the slightest. However me and my friends do make good jokes sometimes when we play. You all that play 10000 hours of this are weird to me.

Edit: I forgot to point out that the game has no "style" unless you consider "generic asset pack" a style

unfortunately, this game started out great, but then with the most recent updates the game has become so complex that its no longer fun, some of the older systems that made the game easier in terms of allowing casual players to hop on and have a good time without being extremely stressed at all times were deleted, including the system of no evidence that a ghost is hunting until its near you, or making the ghost even faster after its already been sped up. it just feels like the game no longer caters to casual "after work" players and only focusing on those who play the game super seriously and almost religiously (no pun intended)

some may like the game in its current state, i personally think they scrapped too many features to make the game much harder in all aspects to where the new amateur feels like the old professional, im sure this comment will go unnoticed by the devs but incase it does, please consider the less "competitive" for a lack of better words audience

I've only tried this game in VR, so I couldn't say how it is playing on a 2D screen, but as far as the VR version goes it's really scary and fun, and social. The fact that you can play with regular PC players also makes sure you always can find a game to join, and you really dont need to have friends playing this game to enjoy it. The asking price is also quite cheap considering how much fun it is. I already got my money worth.

It does have some bugs, like a couple of times I walked through the wall and got teleported back to the truck, but I havent experienced anything gamebreaking. There's also a bunch of PC players playing without mic, but it's no problem kicking them from a game or finding a game with people who has a mic. Microphone is important as you need to be able to talk and listen to other players, and work together to complete the job. Especially at harder difficulties. Also it's 10 times as fun.

This game also gave me nightmares.

tldr.text: Very Positive (94%): players like playing with friends, and 35% of reviews praise the co-op.
The main complaint is bugs and crashes, though fewer recent reviews complain about them.

details.text: Newer players are less positive, at 79%, than players who stayed past the first couple of hours.
A flagged surge of negative reviews in May and June dropped the monthly score to 41%, from a usual 93%, so recent reviews are a better guide for buyers now.
